subject: ios-tegu comparison: CA prefs recovered, ranked integration plan
body:
READ-ONLY analysis, no build/test/phone. Files: work/gpu/build/ios-tegu-compare-20261026/{REPORT.md,ledger.json,make_ledger.py}.
1) Best backboardd: ios-tegu origin/main ee8de4c (R252/R251 baseline: UI renders, 37.6 ms/cmd, 46 pixel probes PASS). Everything after import base 7f6f7ca is CSF/perf (TGJ2 pair, VM/AS1, retained target cache) = NOT APPLICABLE. 312/339 imported frontend files are byte-identical to 7f6f7ca, so R23-R175 backboardd frontend work is source-present; Nord2 overrides (nord2_render_pass.inc, TEGU_INERT_PIPELINES, caps 3,4,6,8,13,14,15,18,20) decide whether it is enabled.
2) ROOT111 CA prefs are NOT in git (prose only). Recovered from the iOS 16.7 QuartzCore in our dsc: CAEnableDeepFramebuffer, CAEnableFramebufferCompression, CAEnableIOSurfaceCompression, each CFPreferencesGetAppBooleanValue(key, kCFPreferencesCurrentApplication); false disables. backboardd runs as mobile. Seed (inferred, unverified): /private/var/mobile/Library/Preferences/{backboardd,.GlobalPreferences}.plist (+ root equivalents), 501:501 0600. This is the missing b3a8 selector lowering-opus asked about. Nord2 tooling has no such seeding. Install only in the UI-Metal-ON stage (work/tools/sweet-root-tweaks.py merge_pref pattern / gpu/tools/stage_metal_root.py).
3) Kernel: 0164 gating NOT APPLICABLE (Nord2GPU::importSurface takes any SweetSurface). MISSING: 0142 surface retention until panel copy (SweetFramebuffer.cpp swap/present resolve ids up to 100 ms later), 0187 multi-layer blend (instrument first), 0184/0185/0189/0192/0197 wallpaper/widget root requirements.
4) Testable risks: (a) nord2_gpu_allocation_size caps each client at 64 MiB and charges imported SweetSurface pages (display surface = 686x16KiB each; 256 MiB advertised/ctx limit disagree) - 3 display surfaces + pipelines may ENOMEM; (b) true-MRT color(1) framebuffer fetch is still a guarded refusal (inert in backboardd) while ios-tegu emulates it per target (57e90f0) - do not count inert as support; (c) NORD2_FRONTEND_DEFINES (TEGU_INERT_PIPELINES) is an env hook, record it in build identity; (d) MTLTextureDescriptor.swizzle still hard identity (render_encoder.inc:2292), also open in ios-tegu.
Owners: kernel/display for 0142/N-12; root installer for prefs; render/lowering for MRT. Parent integrates.
